description: Land Acquisition - Magamure, Kamburupitiya D/S Division, Matara District - Amended Gazette Extraordinary No. 2217/47 dated 05.03.2021
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired, including their boundaries, extents, and locations. The document is an official order for taking possession of land, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land acquisition and property matters. While it mentions a government minister (S. M. Chandrasena), this is incidental to the core land-related content, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would trigger a government classification type.
